role: QA Part Q: entry-by-entry comparison of engines A and B (two-body kernels of Q_1, S_1, K_1), with independent checks
method: Engine B code (qsk/engine_b/src.nosync, read-only import) run on engine A data mapped by the exact spinor intertwiner S of step2/composite_qsk/revise.nosync/ferm_map/spinor_map.json (u_B = S u_A on Sigma, same vector index; letters S^{-T}, outputs and xi S, Sigma^* by (S^T Mp)^{-1}); S = c S0, c^2 = i/16, powers of c tracked. Colour words matched strictly: A ordering (Y_1..Y_r) = word ad_{Y_r}..ad_{Y_1} = B word [r-1..0] with B outputs in A order. Under S, A's lamP is B's lamM (opposite orientations of V); xi_A in A's S_+ (x) W is in B's S_- (x) W^*.
